records.reason: Sea-Bird Scientific is the sole manufacturer and supplier of Sea-Bird products, and they are the only authorized facility equipped to perform service and calibration of Sea-Bird instruments.
We have four Sea-Bird Conductivity, Temperature, and Depth Profilers equipped with Sea-Bird auxiliary sensors that are crucial to further water quality research in the Harmful Algal Blooms group.
We have also procured a Submersible Underwater Nutrient Analyzer (SUNA) sensor and may procure more, and Sea-Bird are the only providers of that sensor.
